questions.q: Work out 800 − 263.
steps: Ones: 0 − 3? Not enough, and the tens are 0. Go to the hundreds (8 becomes 7); each 0 on the way becomes 9. Now 10 − 3 = 7.

questions.q: The blue square is in column 1. It is reflected in the red mirror line. Which column is its reflection in?
steps: Count from the blue square to the mirror: 4 squares.
The reflection is the same distance on the other side: 4 squares after the line.

questions.q: A rectangle is 3 times as long as it is wide. Its perimeter is 48 cm. What is its area?
steps: Width w, length 3w. Perimeter: w + 3w + w + 3w = 8w = 48, so w = 6.
